kit-sales.proposal.title: Proposal for {name}
kit-sales.proposal.none: No proposal for them yet. Pick an offer, and Chausar drafts one from your records.
kit-sales.proposal.pilot: Offer it as a paid pilot first
kit-sales.proposal.pilotHint: A pilot runs 2 to 6 weeks at your own price. A pilot is never free.
kit-sales.proposal.noOffers: Your plan has no offers yet. Add them under Business, Plan.
kit-sales.proposal.waiting: Read it on Today, then approve it. Only then can you send it.
kit-sales.proposal.checksFailed: A check did not pass, so it is not on Today:
kit-sales.proposal.exit.partly: Part of this is outside what you do
kit-sales.proposal.sendLine: Chausar never sends it. Pick where you send it from.
kit-sales.proposal.copied: Copied. Paste it into your message.
kit-sales.goNoGo.heading: Should you try something new?
kit-sales.goNoGo.line: Type what you know. Leave a box empty if you do not know it yet.
kit-sales.goNoGo.subject: What you are deciding
kit-sales.goNoGo.subjectHint: For example: a reels pack for gyms
kit-sales.goNoGo.upfront: What it costs to start, in rupees
kit-sales.goNoGo.monthly: What it costs each month, in rupees
kit-sales.goNoGo.months: How many months you will try it
kit-sales.goNoGo.limit: The most you are willing to lose, in rupees
kit-sales.goNoGo.needSubject: Say what you are deciding first.
kit-sales.goNoGo.says.GO: The most you could lose is within your limit.
kit-sales.goNoGo.says.HOLD: Some answers are missing. Fill them in, then make the card again.
kit-sales.goNoGo.says.NO-GO: The most you could lose is above your limit.
kit-sales.goNoGo.input.months: How many months you will try it
kit-sales.goNoGo.input.limit: The most you are willing to lose
kit-sales.goNoGo.spendsNothing: Go spends nothing: each spend still asks you.
kit-sales.goNoGo.none: No cards yet. Make one before you start something new.
kit-sales.share.line: A share of an amount your client confirms later, like a fee on a hired person's yearly pay. Chausar works the amount out with a receipt once you have it.
kit-sales.share.hint: For example 8.33. Like any price change, it waits on Today.
kit-sales.error.OFFER_UNPRICED: Set a price for this offer first, under Business, Prices.
kit-sales.error.PILOT_UNPRICED: A pilot is never free. Set a price for this offer first, under Business, Prices.
kit-sales.error.PILOT_WINDOW: A pilot runs 2 to 6 weeks, and its success date falls inside it.
kit-sales.error.PILOT_NOT_OFFERED: This offer is not offered as a pilot. Pick another offer.
kit-sales.error.INVALID_SHARE: Type the share as a percent, from 0.01 to 100.
kit-sales.error.INVALID_AMOUNT: Type each amount in rupees, like 20000.
kit-sales.error.SHARE_BASE_MISSING: Record the amount this share is of first, with the file that shows it.
kit-sales.error.SHARE_BASE_UNPROVEN: Add the file that shows this amount, such as the offer letter.
kit-sales.error.APP_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: Do this in the Chausar app on your computer.
